decisions.reason: A flagship, application-specific harvesting crate for the agriculture segment fits the firm's sustainability direction, and tooling investment makes it worth keeping.
Foldable large containers are a core, high-demand returnable packaging line for automotive and industrial customers, and it got its own page in both years.
Stackable crates are a staple product family across food, retail and industrial segments with steady demand.
Rackable pallets are a standard logistics product with broad applications, and the multi-model line supports continued sales.
Spill-retention pallets are a niche line whose website prominence fell from its own page to a mention, but they likely remain a low-cost catalog addition.
This single-model specialty pallet lost its dedicated page and is somewhat at risk, but molded products are typically kept in the catalog while orders continue.
